entities.summary: André Willy Petersson is a Swedish professional ice hockey player, who is currently playing under contract with SCL Tigers of the National League (NL). He was selected by the Ottawa Senators in the 4th round of the 2008 NHL Entry Draft, and played for them for only one NHL game.
